# Element library

Icons usable as `{ "type": "icon", "icon": "<name>" }`. Every icon is drawn stroke by stroke on a 24×24 grid and scaled to `size`. 3D models are at the end.

From [Tabler Icons](https://tabler.io/icons), MIT.

## Logos

Brand logos are drawn as neon outlines. From [Simple Icons](https://simpleicons.org) (CC0); `openai` is a simplified hand-drawn version. Logos are trademarks of their owners: use them to refer to the company or product, not to suggest endorsement.

## 3D (iso) models

Usable as `{ "type": "iso", "model": "<name>" }`. Defined in `src/engine/iso-models.json` as boxes and cylinders.

| Name | What it shows | Parts |
|---|---|---|
| `server-stack` | Stack of four rack servers | 4 |
| `database` | Database: three stacked disks | 3 |
| `gpu-cluster` | 3×3 grid of GPU nodes on a base plate | 10 |
| `chip` | Chip: package with a die on top | 2 |
| `datacenter` | Two rows of four racks | 9 |
| `layers` | Three stacked layers (e.g. app / model / hardware). Explode to separate them. | 3 |
| `podium` | Winners' podium: three blocks for 1st (middle, tallest), 2nd (left) and 3rd (right). Use for leaderboards, rankings, 'who is best'. Reads best with "rotate": -30 (all three blocks in a row). | 4 |
| `document-stack` | A long document as a stack of pages. Explode it to show it being cut into chunks. | 5 |
| `vector-index` | Vector index: a plate with bars standing for stored vectors (embeddings). Use for a vector database or search index in RAG. | 8 |
